result.title: Evidence-Guided Recovery for AI Agents with Ambiguous Tool Outcomes and Partial Execution
result.comment: 24 pages, 1 figure, and 10 tables. Includes a finite recovery model, model-facing confirmation study with two local-model bundles, independent replay, and an explicit provider-capability scope
result.summary: Tool timeouts can leave AI agents facing ambiguous tool outcomes and partial execution: an action may have failed, committed or remained in flight while other workflow steps have already completed. We formulate evidence-guided task recovery over approved obligations, provider capabilities and states compatible with public evidence. A shared admissibility check handles key expiry, authorization timing, dependencies and residual effects; a terminal certificate separates actual goal satisfaction from publicly supported safe completion. The known-model implementation combines standard observation-contingent planning with a separately implemented effect-history adjudicator. In a finite study of 37 assignments, planning and three active controls each certify 28 completions; four saved synthetic fee units incur additional computation. A preregistered assignment-held-out comparison then evaluates planning advice against evidence prompting with two local model bundles. Across 58 paired units in 19 previously developed task families, advice certifies 30 completions versus 9, a 36.2-percentage-point difference (exact family sign-flip p=0.0078), using 272 proposals versus 399. All 116 trajectories pass independent replay. Both models exhibit a positive completion difference. The comparison measures the evaluated advice interface under a common shield; search-versus-rule advice requires a separate matched comparison. Unknown and handoff outcomes remain explicit, with guarantees tied to the declared provider capabilities rather than arbitrary third-party exactly-once execution.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究 AI agent 在工具调用结果不明确（超时可能失败、已提交或仍在执行）且流程部分完成时的恢复问题，提出基于已批准义务、提供方能力与公开证据相容状态的证据引导恢复框架，并用「终止证书」区分真正达成目标与公开证据支持的安全完成，配以可行性检查与效应历史裁定；在有限任务集与预注册对照中比较规划建议与证据提示。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「终止证书」与证据相容性检查可为 LVR 的 STOP 决策与证据充分性判据提供概念线索，但对象是工具型 agent 而非视觉推理，需核查是否能映射到 latent 状态下的停止与残余效应判断。
